short_name.notes: Official abbreviation used throughout AY 2026-2027 Fact Sheet (e.g., AU Intro Days, AU Housing) and international.au.dk.

min_standing_note.value: Bachelor-level courses are open to 2nd- and 3rd-year students (typically >=30 ECTS in field); Master-level courses are reserved for Master's students (>=60 ECTS in field; Law Master's >=100 ECTS).

eligible_auc_schools.notes: Normalized from agreement_scope_raw == 'University-wide' (faculty/subject exclusions documented in excluded_majors and course_restrictions_note).

eligible_majors.notes: Normalized from agreement_scope_raw == 'University-wide' (subject-level exclusions noted in excluded_majors).

value: Medicine (limited clinical capacity; specific bilateral placement required)
excluded_majors.notes: Dentistry (Danish-only) and Medicine (limited clinical capacity) exclusions documented on AU Course Information & Restrictions page; AY 2026-2027 Fact Sheet (Brev.pdf#page=3) separately states the 1-faculty/1-department rule.

min_gpa_host.notes: No centralized university-wide minimum GPA published in AY 2026-2027 fact sheet or AU incoming exchange pages.

english_course_availability.notes: AY 2026-2027 Fact Sheet p.3 states 'A wide variety of courses are taught in English. However, the selection of courses varies from semester to semester.'

english_proficiency_and_rhet1020.value: Expected English proficiency comparable to TOEFL iBT 83 or IELTS 6.5 (no RHET 1020 exemption stated). Documentation varies by faculty: Aarhus BSS (none required); Health (none required); Arts (required for English degree programme only); Natural Sciences and Technical Sciences (documentation may be required).

host_language_requirement.value: None required for English-taught exchange courses (Danish required only for Danish-taught courses such as Dentistry; optional Danish language courses offered).
host_language_requirement.notes: Dentistry Danish-language rule documented on AU Course Information & Restrictions page; optional Danish language courses linked in Brev.pdf#page=4.

fall_term_dates.value: Autumn semester (AY 2026-2027): Mandatory AU Intro Days late-August/early-September; Courses late-August to late-January; Exam period mid-December to late-January (exact dates vary by study programme).

spring_term_dates.value: Spring semester (AY 2026-2027): Mandatory AU Intro Days late-January/early-February; Courses late-January to late-June; Exam period mid-May to late-June (exact dates vary by study programme).

tuition_model.notes: Tuition-free bilateral exchange under active AUC agreement; also see https://international.au.dk/education/admissions/exchange.

est_monthly_living_local.notes: AY 2026-2027 Fact Sheet p.4 publishes 'Monthly estimate 1.000' EUR (itemized breakdown sums to 805-1,055 EUR: Housing 350-600 EUR, Meals 300 EUR, Books 25 EUR, Local transportation 30 EUR, Personal expenses incl. insurance 100 EUR). Official web also notes AU Housing ~3,000-4,000 DKK/mo and SIRI visa financial threshold DKK 7,086/mo.

living_cost_usd_est.notes: Converted from AU AY 2026-2027 official monthly estimate of 1,000 EUR over 5 months: 1000 EUR * 5 * FX rate 1.1052 USD/EUR = 5,526.00 USD. FX rate 1 EUR = 1.1052 USD (and 1 EUR = 7.4756 DKK; 1 DKK = 0.147841 USD) from ECB Euro reference exchange rates for 2026-11-13 (latest prior to 2026-11-15), retrieved 2026-11-15 at https://www.ecb.europa.eu/stats/policy_and_exchange_rates/euro_reference_exchange_rates/html/index.en.html.

mandatory_host_fees_and_insurance.value: No mandatory host tuition or student union fee stated for exchange students. Stays >3 months are covered by Danish Health Insurance once issued a CPR number; stays <3 months require private health insurance. Students must arrange private travel, personal belongings, accident, and third-party liability insurance.

housing_availability.notes: AU Housing assists incoming exchange students via an optional portal integrated with admission, but explicitly states housing is not guaranteed.

housing_notes.value: Optional AU Housing application is integrated into the admission application (deadlines Apr 1 Autumn / Oct 1 Spring). No housing guarantee; offers sent by Jul 1 (Autumn) and Dec 15 (Spring) with a 48-hour acceptance window requiring credit/debit card payment of 600 DKK non-refundable booking fee + first month's rent (deposit of 1-3 months' rent billed with 2nd month's rent). Estimated AU Housing rent 350-600 EUR/mo (~3,000-4,000 DKK/mo); AU advises applying to Student Housing Aarhus (Ungdomsbolig Aarhus) as backup.
housing_notes.notes: Timing and 350-600 EUR estimate also corroborated in Brev.pdf#page=2 and #page=4.

host_grants_or_stipends.notes: Erasmus+ is EU-programme-specific and Danish Government Scholarships apply to full-degree students; no incoming bilateral exchange grant confirmed for AUC students.

visa_lead_time_and_financial_proof.value: Non-EU/EEA students staying >3 months require a Danish student residence permit via SIRI. Normal processing takes up to 2 months (~60 days; up to 3 months if additional documentation is needed). Financial proof required: monthly funds matching the Danish SU grant benchmark (DKK 7,086/month at 2025 level, covering the full stay) in the student's own bank account.

exchange_page_url.notes: Official incoming exchange URL embedded as hyperlink in AY 2026-2027 Fact Sheet p.4.

course_catalog_url.notes: Official Aarhus University English course catalogue portal.

english_course_list_url.notes: No separate static English-only course list URL; filter Teaching language = English and Course type = Exchange at https://kursuskatalog.au.dk/en/.

credit_system_and_load.value: ECTS; full-time study workload is 30 ECTS per semester (Danish grading scale: 12, 10, 7, 4, 02 passing; 00, -03 fail; some pass/fail exams).

course_restrictions_note.value: Students must select courses from 1 faculty only (and most faculties allow 1 department only, per Brev.pdf#page=3). Law offers no Bachelor-level English courses (Master-level Law requires >=100 ECTS); Dentistry is Danish-only via faculty agreements; Medicine international semester has limited clinical capacity and requires Bachelor/3 years Medicine, C1 English, and clinical experience.
course_restrictions_note.notes: 1-faculty/1-department rule corroborated in Brev.pdf#page=3; Law/Dentistry/Medicine subject rules come from AU official web course-information-restrictions.

value: Official university transcript of records (PDF in English)
Bachelor's degree diploma & transcript (if already earned and applying for Master-level courses)
Documentation of English language skills (faculty/department-dependent; not required for Aarhus BSS or Health)
Passport number (entered in the online application form)
required_application_docs.notes: Required document checklist verified at international.au.dk (and .../education/exchange/how-to-apply); faculty-specific English documentation rules detailed in Brev.pdf#page=3.

academic_style.value: Informal classroom culture with flat hierarchy (first-name basis with faculty), open critical discussion, and independent study; some courses enforce mandatory attendance for exam eligibility.

city_tier.notes: Aarhus is Denmark's second-largest city (>370,000 inhabitants per international.au.dk), mapped to mid_size_city.

campus_type.notes: Aarhus University operates nationwide campuses in Aarhus (main campus), Emdrup (Copenhagen), Herning, Viborg, Roskilde, and Flakkebjerg.

daily_life_english_friendliness.notes: au.dk explicitly notes Denmark ranks among the highest countries globally in English proficiency and accommodates English speakers in daily life and university services.

international_support_services.value: Mandatory AU Intro Days (orientation before semester start with CPR/residence guidance, campus tours, social events), mentor/buddy contact via email where applicable, AU International Student Guide app, and Danish language courses.
international_support_services.notes: Further student arrival and mentor/language details on Brev.pdf#page=4.

nomination_deadlines.value: Autumn semester (AY 2026-2027): Nomination 15 Feb - 25 Mar, Application 1 Mar - 1 Apr. Spring semester (AY 2026-2027): Nomination 15 Aug - 25 Sep, Application 1 Sep - 1 Oct (housing application deadline is the same).
nomination_deadlines.notes: Also listed in nomination summary table on Brev.pdf#page=1.
